methods.method_description: Verifies the presence of the new HP app popup skip button.

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Flag to raise exception if element not found

methods.method_output_parameter: WebElement or boolean indicating if new HP app popup skip button is present
methods.method_purpose: Checks if the new HP app popup with skip button is displayed, allowing flexible verification with exception raising.

methods.method_description: Verifies the home navigation by checking app bar MFE.

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Flag to raise exception if element not found

methods.method_output_parameter: WebElement or boolean indicating if app bar MFE is present
methods.method_purpose: Confirms home navigation is accessible by delegating to verify_app_bar_mfe with timeout and exception control.

methods.method_description: Verifies the presence of a Windows dummy printer device.
methods.method_output_parameter: WebElement representing the Windows dummy printer device
methods.method_purpose: Checks for dummy printer using recent device list XML file as a temporary workaround due to unavailable printer addition.

methods.method_description: Verifies the app bar MFE section is present.

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Flag to raise exception if element not found

methods.method_output_parameter: WebElement or boolean indicating if app bar MFE section is present
methods.method_purpose: Checks if the main app bar MFE section is loaded and visible with configurable timeout and exception handling.

methods.method_description: Verifies the device status section exists (not necessarily displayed).
methods.method_output_parameter: WebElement representing the device status section
methods.method_purpose: Checks for device status section presence in DOM regardless of visibility.

methods.method_description: Verifies the account panel section is present.
methods.method_output_parameter: WebElement representing the account panel section
methods.method_purpose: Checks if the side panel account section is available.

methods.method_description: Verifies user is logged in by checking sign-in button is invisible.

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Flag to raise exception if element is still visible

methods.method_output_parameter: Boolean indicating if sign-in button is invisible (user logged in)
methods.method_purpose: Checks logged-in state by confirming the sign-in button is not visible using inverse verification pattern.

methods.method_description: Verifies that a device card is displayed.
